source_observation.risk: An adapter that derives its ordered heard-result aggregate from SESSION_CLOSE.packet_refs can bind a deterministic but semantically reordered payload when packet_id lexical order differs from output sequence order.

required_discriminator: Add a WP717 regression in which packet_id lexical order intentionally opposes sequence order. The admitted heard-result digest must bind the canonical full VoiceOutputPacket payloads in the declared semantic output order; reversed, omitted, duplicated, or packet-ref-only aggregates must fail closed. The adapter must not infer semantic order from SESSION_CLOSE.packet_refs alone.
next_exact_action: WP717 mutation owner should absorb this discriminator into VSR multi-segment order testing before repository acceptance. If implementation already canonicalizes directly from ordered VoiceOutputPacket values independent of SESSION_CLOSE.packet_refs, retain this as a regression proving that invariant.
